## What and why / 改了什么，为什么？

<!-- Link a related issue if there is one. For a project addition, include its source and disclose if you maintain it. / 有关联 issue 请链接；推荐项目请附来源，是自己的项目请说明。 -->

## Checks / 验证结果

<!-- List commands and results, or say what was not tested. / 写测试命令和结果；没测的请说明。 -->

- [ ] I checked the change and source links; claims match the evidence. / 已自查改动和来源链接，描述与证据一致。
- [ ] I updated both READMEs and counts where needed. / 已按需同步中英文 README 和数量。
- [ ] I ran applicable tests and `git diff --check`; no secrets or private data are included. / 已运行适用测试及 `git diff --check`，未包含密钥或私人数据。
